title: Gimbal video audio: 'a whole fleet of them'
summary: Unnamed Navy aircrew tells of Gimbal video audio: 'a whole fleet of them', about 2015 at Off the US East Coast (Roosevelt, 2014 to 2015), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a whole fleet of them. Look on ASA.

related.note: The Gimbal crew audio saying 'a whole fleet of them' is about the same fleet accompanying the Gimbal object in 2015. The story only says the formation was possibly there, while this telling hears it stated by the crew on the tape.

plain: The Gimbal video is cockpit footage that Navy aircrew recorded around 2015 off the US East Coast, showing an unknown object that seems to rotate in the air. On the recording, one of the crew can be heard saying "there's a whole fleet of them" and telling another to look at the radar screen. If taken at face value, it means the crew saw not one strange object but a group of them.
